housing.summary: Numbeo reported a contributor-based average of EUR 662.50 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Córdoba city centre, last updated 19 June 2026. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Cordoba-Spain Article 36 of the Spanish Urban Leases Act sets the mandatory cash deposit for a dwelling at one month of rent. Source: https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1994-26003&tn=1 Idealista provides a Córdoba rental-listings portal. Source: https://www.idealista.com/en/alquiler-viviendas/cordoba-cordoba/

banking.summary: For the Santander Non-Resident Account, applicants must be over 18 and provide a valid passport; Spanish non-residents may use a DNI. Foreign tax residents identify themselves with an NIE, while EU residents need their EU Citizen Registration Certificate and passport. Source: https://www.bancosantander.es/en/particulares/cuentas-bancarias/cuenta-online-con-pasaporte
required_docs: Valid passport for a foreign non-resident
NIE for a foreign tax resident
EU Citizen Registration Certificate plus passport for an EU resident

schools.summary: The British School of Córdoba documents the English National Curriculum and Cambridge IGCSE in secondary, and the IB Diploma Programme plus AS and A Level options in sixth form. Sources: https://www.colegiobritanicodecordoba.com/en/curriculum/secondary https://colegiobritanicodecordoba.com/en/curriculum/sixth-form The NABSS directory identifies it as the only authorised British school in the province. Source: https://nabss.org/colegios-nabss/british-school-of-cordoba/

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer establishing residence in Córdoba registers or changes address in the Municipal Population Register by completing form 60-444 and submitting identity and occupancy evidence to Córdoba City Council. Foreign nationals provide an NIE or valid passport; EU foreign nationals provide an NIE and a current identity document from their country of origin. Source: https://www.cordoba.es/tramites/padron-de-habitantes/alta-o-inscripcion-y-traslado-de-domicilio-en-el-padron-municipal-de-habitantes
legal_admin.registration_step: Register the Córdoba address in the Padrón Municipal de Habitantes using form 60-444 and the required identity and occupancy documents

tax_finance.summary: A natural person needs a Spanish NIF for tax-relevant transactions; it generally coincides with the DNI or NIE. A foreign national without a DNI or NIE can request a NIF from the Spanish Tax Agency using Modelo 030. Source: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/censos-nif-domicilio-fiscal/solicitar-nif.html
tax_finance.tax_id_name: NIF (generally the NIE for a foreign national)

transport.summary: AUCORSA is the municipal company providing public urban transport in Córdoba. Source: https://aucorsa.es/quienes-somos/ Its subsidised Tarjeta 30 días costs EUR 20 for 2026. Source: https://aucorsa.es/titulos-y-tarifas/ EU and EEA licences remain valid while current; qualifying non-EU licences are valid for at most six months after normal residence begins, then must be exchanged where an agreement exists or replaced by obtaining a Spanish licence. Source: https://www.dgt.es/nuestros-servicios/permisos-de-conducir/permisos-extranjeros-y-de-fuerzas-y-cuerpos-de-seguridad/conducir-con-un-permiso-extranjero Andalusian residents whose public coverage is recognised by INSS apply at the nearest primary-care centre with identity, INSS coverage proof and empadronamiento, using the health-card or BDU registration form. Source: https://www.sspa.juntadeandalucia.es/servicioandaluzdesalud/ciudadania/cobertura-sanitaria/personas-residentes-en-andalucia-con-cobertura-sanitaria
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU and EEA licences are valid while current. Other qualifying foreign licences are valid for up to six months after normal residence begins; afterwards exchange is required where an agreement exists, otherwise a new Spanish licence must be obtained.
transport.healthcare_registration: After INSS recognises public coverage, apply for primary-care registration and the Andalusian health card at the nearest health centre with identity, INSS coverage proof and a certificate of empadronamiento.
